answers.core: I can't think of any downsides except performance which only happens if you actively use the render mode. And there are so many flaws with transparency handling in-engine, so it would be nice to have it built in.
answers.workaround: I can't actually think of any solution whatsoever, which is why I am writing this. If there were a work-around that was somewhat convenient I would use it (if one exists let me know!)
